programme.name: Universal Evolution Intelligence
programme.mission: Constitutionalize evolution intelligence so the repository, its knowledge and its architecture improve themselves under governance — by binding the observation, learning, optimization, recommendation, impact-analysis, simulation, discovery, planning, execution, continuous-improvement, continuous-optimization, prediction and evolution capability that already exists in this repository, reusing it verbatim, duplicating nothing, and placing every one of them under a located governing instrument.

outputs.title: Universal Evolution Intelligence — Dashboard
outputs.purpose: The single-glance state of the programme: capability coverage, evolution-lifecycle binding, continuous-loop binding, governance coverage, validation, and the Evolution Intelligence Gate verdict.

outputs.title: Universal Evolution Intelligence Constitution
outputs.purpose: The whole contract in one instrument: the fifteen constitutional evolution capabilities, the evolution lifecycle they own, the continuous loops they drive, the governance obligation over each, and the inheritance rule for every future autonomous programme.

outputs.title: Universal Observation Specification
outputs.purpose: What the platform must observe, from which located instrumentation, so that evolution is driven by measured reality and never by assertion.

outputs.title: Universal Learning Specification
outputs.purpose: How observation becomes retained, searchable institutional knowledge, so no architectural question is answered twice and every decision is recoverable.

outputs.title: Universal Optimization Specification
outputs.purpose: The semantics-preserving, traceability-preserving optimization contract: what may be improved, what may never be lost, and how the improvement is proven.

outputs.title: Universal Recommendation Specification
outputs.purpose: How the platform derives what to do next — ranked, evidence-cited, never invented — from the located intelligence engines.

outputs.title: Universal Impact Analysis Specification
outputs.purpose: The pre-change consequence contract: blast radius, propagation distance, layers and capabilities reached, certified surface disturbed, bounded risk score.

outputs.title: Universal Simulation Specification
outputs.purpose: How a proposed evolution is executed against a model before it is executed against the repository: digital twin, hermetic reproduction, deterministic replay.

outputs.title: Universal Improvement Discovery Specification
outputs.purpose: How improvement opportunities are discovered rather than guessed: duplicate, conflict, orphan, missing-knowledge, coverage, consistency and drift dimensions.

outputs.title: Universal Evolution Planning Specification
outputs.purpose: How a discovered improvement becomes an ordered, dependency-respecting, critical-path-aware plan bound to the located roadmap owners.

outputs.title: Universal Evolution Execution Specification
outputs.purpose: How a plan is executed under governance: authorized, coordinated, scheduled, checkpointed, reversible, and evidenced.

outputs.title: Continuous Improvement Specification
outputs.purpose: The always-on improvement loop: the located gates, entry points and automation that make improvement a standing obligation rather than an event.

outputs.title: Continuous Optimization Specification
outputs.purpose: The always-on optimization loop: coverage, measurement and determinism held at or above their proven level, with regression fail-closed.

outputs.title: Universal Future Prediction Specification
outputs.purpose: What the platform may predict, from which derived state, and the honesty constraint: a prediction is a computed projection of located evidence or it is not emitted.

outputs.title: Repository Evolution Specification
outputs.purpose: How the repository itself evolves: census, drift against the prior snapshot, the change ledger and its evolution timeline, and staged repository operations.

outputs.title: Knowledge Evolution Specification
outputs.purpose: How knowledge evolves without loss: canonical homes, normalization, closure, and certification of the knowledge corpus across every increment.

outputs.title: Architecture Evolution Specification
outputs.purpose: How architecture evolves under freeze: layer discipline, the decision record, the freeze boundary, and the amendment route that governs any change to a frozen surface.

outputs.title: Evolution Lifecycle Determination
outputs.purpose: The required end-to-end evolution lifecycle and the standing continuous loops, each step bound to the capability that owns it and to a covered repository home.

outputs.title: Governance Binding Determination
outputs.purpose: The proof of the mission clause "everything governed": every capability carries a governance obligation bound to a located governing instrument, with no capability ungoverned.

outputs.title: Validation Report
outputs.purpose: The mandatory validation dimensions of evolution intelligence and their computed result.

outputs.title: Certification Report
outputs.purpose: The certification determination over the whole evolution-intelligence capability set, computed from Repository Truth and never asserted.

outputs.purpose: The exit criteria of the directive and whether the platform is ready to evolve itself under this contract.

outputs.title: Continuation Package
outputs.purpose: The deterministic hand-off: completed work, remaining work, dependency state, open issues, architectural decisions, roadmap and the recommended next programme.

capabilities.name: Universal Observation
capabilities.objective: Continuously observe the platform, the corpus and the execution substrate so that every subsequent inference is grounded in measured reality rather than assertion.
required_properties: metric observation with declared units and deterministic ordering
distributed trace observation across execution boundaries
structured log observation with no secret disclosure
threshold alerting with a located owner for every alert
immutable audit observation of every governed action
external-signal ingestion appended, never overwritten
health observation of every registered subsystem
observation is read-only over its subject and mutates nothing it observes
capabilities.reuse: The observability platform already realises metrics, traces, logs, alerting, audit and health (EC2-EPIC-013); the engine foundation already realises execution telemetry; the advancement connectors already ingest external signals into an append-only signal store. This programme binds them; it introduces no new observation mechanism.

capabilities.name: Universal Learning
capabilities.objective: Convert observation into retained, searchable institutional knowledge so that nothing already learned is learned again and every prior decision is recoverable.
required_properties: every observation that changes understanding is retained as a knowledge object
retained knowledge is searchable deterministically without wall-clock dependence
the Knowledge Once Principle: no architectural question is answered twice
every constitutional decision is registered with a disposition
learned knowledge carries its evidence reference and its canonical home
learning is additive — a later increment never silently overwrites an earlier one
knowledge with no located home is a finding, not a silence
capabilities.reuse: The knowledge engine already realises the institutional-memory store, the constitutional knowledge objects, the intelligence query surface and knowledge certification (UKDA); the decision-assimilation programme already registers every constitutional decision with a disposition; the knowledge-closure programme already homes every concept. This programme binds them; it introduces no new learning mechanism.

capabilities.name: Universal Optimization

required_properties: every transform is semantics-preserving
every transform is traceability-preserving — the provenance chain survives
no derivable behaviour is removed and no behaviour is invented
optimization output is byte-stable, so optimizing twice is a no-op
the provenance chain is re-asserted after every transform
the measure being optimized is located and computed, never estimated
an optimization that cannot be proven is not applied

This programme binds them; it introduces no new optimizer.

capabilities.name: Universal Recommendation

recommendations are deterministically ordered, so the same state yields the same ranking
the execution frontier — what is ready now — is computed, not curated

This programme binds them; it introduces no new recommender.

exit_criteria.criterion: observation is bound to located instrumentation
learning is retained in a located institutional store
improvement is discovered across every declared dimension
evolution planning is dependency- and critical-path-aware
evolution execution is authorized, checkpointed and reversible
improvement is a standing automated obligation
prediction is a computed function of located evidence
architecture evolution is contained by freeze and amendment

governance.obligation: Observation is an audited, evidence-producing act: what is observed, and the disclosure limits on it, are governed rather than left to the observer.
Learning is traceable: every retained item of knowledge carries the evidence that produced it and the canonical home that owns it.
Optimization may not alter meaning: an optimization that changes semantics is an amendment and follows the amendment route, not the optimization route.
Recommendation holds no authority: it proposes and never ratifies, and the located recommendation instrument owns the constitutional recommendation surface.
Impact analysis precedes change: no evolution touching a certified or frozen surface proceeds without its blast radius computed and recorded.
Simulation must be reproducible to be admissible: a simulation result that cannot be regenerated byte-identically is not evidence.
A discovered gap must be registered and classified: discovery may not be discarded, and an unregistered gap is a governance failure.
Planning is bound by the located sequencing authority: a plan may order work but may not invent authority to do it.
Execution is constitutionally governed: every executed step is authorized, evidenced and recoverable under the execution constitution.
The continuous improvement loop is itself governed: changing the loop requires the governance route, so the loop cannot be weakened silently.
Every proven measure is a validation obligation: continuous optimization is enforced through the validation constitution, not through convention.
Prediction may not manufacture certainty: a projection is derived truth, carries no authority, and declares the absence it cannot compute.
Repository change follows the change-intelligence and regeneration standard: no repository evolution bypasses the located change route.
Knowledge evolution is certified: an increment that does not close and certify the corpus does not count as evolved.
Architecture evolution is contained by freeze: a frozen surface changes only through the freeze and amendment instruments, never in place.

continuation.completed_work: Ω∞-001B Universal Evolution Intelligence: the fifteen evolution-intelligence capabilities discovered, bound to the repository homes that already realise them, placed under a located governing instrument each, validated, and certified; the twenty-three deliverables — the last of which is this continuation package — generated by uei_engine.py; the Evolution Intelligence Gate wired into the developer entry points, continuous integration and the session-start hook. Binding into the aggregate constitutional gate is NOT done and remains the deferred, non-blocking follow-up recorded under remaining work.
continuation.remaining_work: None blocking internal to Ω∞-001B. The capability is inheritable and active through three independent mechanisms: the session-start hook (.kiro/hooks/uei-000001.json), continuous integration (.github/workflows/uei-gate.yml), and the developer entry points (make uei / make uei-gate / make uei-self). One authorized, non-blocking follow-up remains available: an additive binding of the Evolution Intelligence Gate into the aggregate constitutional gate (00-MASTER/UCCEP-000000/uccep-bindings.json) as a new check plus gate entry — deferred here because it would also require the aggregate engine to render a corresponding determination, which is outside this programme's non-destructive, reuse-first boundary. Any future proven evolution capability is added as a capability entry plus its output, validation, exit criterion, lifecycle step and governance obligation in uei-evolution.json, requiring no engine change.
continuation.dependency_state: This programme consumes only already-certified capability and adds no runtime dependency: the observability platform (EC2-EPIC-013), the knowledge engine and its closure programme, the compiler optimization stage (EPIC-003), the architecture-intelligence layer over the certified knowledge graph (EPIC-010 over EPIC-002), the determinism engine (EPIC-004), the execution runtime (EPIC-005), the repository-operations and runtime-operations platforms (EPIC-PLAT-003, EC2-EPIC-012), the coverage and measurement platforms, the repository intelligence engine, and the execution-resilience contract (Ω∞-001A) whose recovery guarantees evolution execution inherits rather than restates. The engine itself is stdlib-only and imports nothing from the repository.
continuation.open_issues: The aggregate-gate roster binding is unregistered by design (authorization required, as for the sibling programmes). The architecture-intelligence modules under engine/graph/architecture/ are evidenced by the certified knowledge-graph completion report, the Affects-closure projection tests and their own evidence module rather than by dedicated per-module test files; a future increment may add per-module tests, which would be an addition to the evidence list in the declaration and requires no engine change.
continuation.architectural_decisions: Four decisions govern the shape of this programme. First, reuse before create: not one observation, learning, optimization, recommendation, impact, simulation, discovery, planning, execution, measurement or evolution mechanism is authored here; every capability is a binding to a located home, and a guard proves no home lies inside this programme's own directory. Second, the contract is DATA: the engine names no capability, mandate or validation dimension, so extending the contract is an edit to the declaration, and a guard proves it. Third, rendering is driven by a renderer registry bound per output in the declaration rather than by positional index, so a sixteenth capability is added by declaring it and needs no renderer change. Fourth, everything governed: a capability with no governance obligation whose instrument resolves against Repository Truth closes the gate, which is how the mission's governance clause becomes verifiable rather than rhetorical.
continuation.implementation_roadmap: Near term: bind the Evolution Intelligence Gate into the aggregate constitutional gate once authorized, and record the programme in the master state instrument. Medium term: promote the currently informational continuous-optimization thresholds into declared, located threshold owners so a regression names the exact measure it regressed. Long term: close the loop the lifecycle describes by feeding the emitted machine-readable model back in as an observed signal, so the programme's own evolution is itself observed, learned from and projected under the same contract.
continuation.recommended_next_programme: The aggregate-gate binding follow-up (a data-only addition to the aggregate roster covering both Ω∞-001A and Ω∞-001B), followed by a programme that consumes this contract end to end: take one discovered improvement from the discovery capability through impact, prediction, simulation, plan and governed execution, and certify the round trip — thereby proving the lifecycle in practice rather than in specification.
